t: Office Of The Attache Of The Ministry Of Communications Of The Japanese Embassy In China, Located At 805 Ave.

pages.en:
TRANSLATION OF

SUBJECT : Office of the Attache of the Ministry of Communications
of the Japanese Embassy in China, located at 805 Ave.Foch.

REFERENCE : Japanese Embassy in China.
Protection of foreign notables residing in the French
Concession.
Report No. 4789 of January 7, 1937.

（批：Feb. 5
Ref it up）
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
GENERAL DRAFTING
13 JAN. 1937）
（批：JAP）

As mentioned in our report 1485/B of December 19, 1936 the
installation at No. 805 Avenue Foch of the Office of the Attache
of the Ministry of Communications to the Japanese Embassy in
China. We also indicated in this report that the gentleman
acting as Attache was Mr. T. YAMATO.

On January 7, 1937 the Municipality forwarded to us under
reference No. 4789 a printed note from Mr. YAMATO (see translation
attached of this document) and a rough plan indicating the locat-
ion of No. 805 Avenue Foch.

According to enquiries put in hand, it appears that Mr.
YAMATO, an officer of the Ministry of Communications of the
Japanese Government, has been detached to the Japanese Embassy in
China, with a view to improving the present state of communicat-
ions between the two countries. His most important work
relates to matters affecting telegraph services, mails, maritime
communications, aviation, radio, etc., etc.,........

It is to be noted, however, that representatives of the Mun-
icipality of Greater Shanghai and the Telegraphic Administration
of the Ministry of Communications of the Chinese Government, when
approached by us, stated that they had not been informed of the
installation in Shanghai of the offices of the Attache of the
Ministry of Communications of the Tokyo Government. These two
administrations knew nothing of the matter.

On the other hand, Mr. CHEN CHOW (陈 □ ), Chief of the
local office of the Unichinopon, No. 6 Tifeng Road, informed our
Chief Inspector No. 261 that about ten days ago he had received

pages.zh:
译文

事由：日本驻华大使馆交通部随员办公室，位于霞飞路805号。

参考：日本驻华大使馆。
保护居住在法租界的外国要人。
1937年1月7日第4789号报告。

（批注：2月5日
归档备查）
（印章：上海工部局
总起草处
1937年1月13日）
（批注：日本）

正如我们在1936年12月19日的第1485/B号报告中所述，日本驻华大使馆交通部随员办公室已设于霞飞路805号。我们在该报告中还指出，担任随员职务的是大和（T. YAMATO）先生。

1937年1月7日，工部局通过第4789号参考文件向我们转发了大和（YAMATO）先生的一份印刷便函（见附件中该文件的译文）以及一份标明霞飞路805号位置的草图。

根据所进行的查询，大和（YAMATO）先生系日本政府交通部官员，被派往日本驻华大使馆，旨在改善两国目前的通讯状况。他的主要工作涉及电报服务、邮政、海运、航空、无线电等方面……

然而值得注意的是，当我们接洽大上海市政府代表和中国政府交通部电政管理局时，他们表示并未获知东京政府交通部随员办公室在上海设立之事。这两个机构对此事一无所知。

另一方面，提篮桥路6号“Unichinopon”（音译）当地办事处主任陈周（CHEN CHOW，陈 □ ）告知我方第261号巡长，大约十天前他曾接待

（批注：DS S.B. / 副本已发送给 Maja 7. Mty S.）

pages.en:
- 2 -

a visit from a member of the Japanese Embassy, who informed him
of the existence of an office of the Attache of the Ministry of
Communications of the Government at the Embassy at No. 25 Whangpoo
Road and that the personnel of this office were residing at No.
805 Avenue Foch.

In finishing this report it should be stated that No. 805
Avenue Foch has been probably chosen for its proximity to the
Japanese Embassy (128 Seymour Road) and to the residence of Mr.
IWAI, Commercial Attache (837, Avenue Foch).

------
pages.zh:
- 2 -

一位日本大使馆成员的来访，该成员告知他，政府在黄浦路25号大使馆内设有交通部随员办公室，且该办公室人员居住在霞飞路805号。

在结束本报告之际，应指出的是，选择霞飞路805号可能是因为其靠近日本大使馆（西摩路128号）以及商务随员岩井（IWAI）先生的寓所（霞飞路837号）。

------

pages.en:
December 15, 1936.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that I have been
sent to Shanghai and attached to the Japanese Embassy in
Shanghai by the Ministry of Communications with the object
of introducing improvements in the realm of communications
between China and Japan.

The necessary preparations, carried out by the
Japanese Bureau of Telegraphs since November 11, 1935,
now having been finished, offices have been installed
on December 15 at the following addresses:-

First Office: No. 805 Avenue Foch, French Concession.
Office of the Representative (Resident
Official) of the Ministry of Communications.

Second Office: 2nd. Floor of the Japanese Embassy, No. 25
Whangpoo Road, Shanghai.

Signed: T. YAMATO.

Secretary of the Ministry of Communications
and concurrently secretary of the Ministry
of Foreign Affairs.
pages.zh:
1936年12月15日。

先生：

谨此通知阁下，本人受交通部派遣前往上海，并附属于日本驻上海大使馆，旨在引入措施以改善中日之间的通讯状况。

自1935年11月11日以来由日本电报局进行的必要准备工作现已完成，办公室已于12月15日在以下地址设立：

第一办公室：法租界霞飞路805号。
交通部代表（驻任官员）办公室。

第二办公室：上海黄浦路25号日本大使馆二楼。

签署：大和（T. YAMATO）。

兼外交部秘书
